name: Saint Francis Xavier
history: One of the first companions of Saint Ignatius of Loyola, he became the greatest missionary since Saint Paul, preaching in India, the Malay archipelago and Japan, and baptising tens of thousands. He died on an island off the coast of China, waiting to enter it.
meditation: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world and lose his soul? Ignatius asked him this until he gave his life away.
life: Francis was born in 1506 at the castle of Xavier in Navarre. At the University of Paris he shared rooms with Peter Faber and then with Ignatius of Loyola, who slowly won the ambitious young teacher for Christ. In 1534 the friends made their vows at Montmartre, the beginning of the Society of Jesus. In 1541, at the request of the King of Portugal, Francis sailed for the Indies and reached Goa the next year. He taught the faith to the fishing people of southern India, then worked in Malacca and the Moluccas, ringing a bell in the streets to call children to the catechism. In 1549 he reached Japan and spent two years there, adapting his ways to its culture. Hoping to enter China, he fell ill on the island of Shangchuan and died there in 1552. His body lies at Goa.
prayerTo: Saint Francis Xavier, you gave up your ambitions to carry the Gospel to the ends of the earth. Pray for missionaries, and for all who have not yet heard of Christ. Stir up in me a zeal for souls, and help me to bring the love of God to the people around me, wherever He sends me. Amen.
penance: Give an offering to a missionary society today, and pray a decade of the Rosary for missionaries and the peoples they serve.
prayer: O God, You Who were pleased to gather into Your Church the peoples of the Indies by the preaching and miracles of blessed Francis, mercifully grant that we, who honor his glorious merits, may also imitate the example of his virtues. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
